steps.title: Create class extending HTMLElement.
steps.description: We're creating a new class called `MyCe` that extends the `HTMLElement` class.

steps.title: Define constructor method.
steps.description: The `constructor` method is called when a new instance of the custom element is created. This is where you can set up the initial state of the custom element.

steps.title: Call super() method.
steps.description: The `super()` method is called to create a new instance of the `HTMLElement` class.

steps.title: Add a template
steps.description: The text content of the custom element is set to `"Hello, World!"`.

steps.title: Define custom element.
steps.description: The custom element is defined using the `customElements.define()` method. The first argument is the name of the custom element, and the second argument is the class that defines the custom element.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: And now you can use your custom element with the tag `<my-ce></my-ce>`.

steps.title: Attach shadow DOM.
steps.description: Instead of adding content directly to the element, create a shadow root using the `attachShadow` method.

steps.title: Set shadow DOM content.
steps.description: The inner HTML of the shadow DOM is set to a paragraph with the text `"Hello, Shadow DOM!"`.

steps.title: Add a style.
steps.description: You can add a `style` tag to the shadow DOM to style the content of the custom element.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: And now you have simple custom element with Shadow DOM and encapsulated style.

hero.copy: Slot content into elements shadow DOM.

steps.title: Add a default slot to the template.
steps.description: Add a `slot` element to the shadow DOM to define where the content of the custom element will be placed.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: And now you can slot content into your custom element.

hero.copy: Precisely slot content into elements shadow DOM.

steps.title: Add named slots to the template.
steps.description: Add couple of `slot` elements to the shadow DOM with `name` attribute to define where the content of the custom element will be placed.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: And now you can precisely slot content into your custom element.

hero.copy: Expose properties on a custom element.

steps.title: Initialize private property.
steps.description: This is optional, but it's always good to have some defaults.

steps.title: Define getter method.
steps.description: A getter method for the `name` property is defined to return the value of `_name`.

steps.title: Define setter method.
steps.description: A setter method for the `name` property is defined to set the value of `_name` and update the text content of the element.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: Now you can set `name` with `myCe.name = 'New Name'` and get it with `console.log(myCe.name)`.

hero.copy: React to attribute changes on a custom element.

steps.title: Define observed attributes.
steps.description: The `observedAttributes` static method returns an array of attribute names to observe.

steps.title: Define attributeChangedCallback.
steps.description: The `attributeChangedCallback` method is called when an observed attribute changes. It updates the text content of the element based on the new attribute value.

steps.title: React to attribute changes.
steps.description: When the `name` attribute changes, the `attributeChangedCallback` method is called which gives you a chance to update your state or template.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: Now you can set `name` attribute with `<my-ce name="New Name"></my-ce>` and see the text content change.

hero.copy: Emit custom events from your element.

steps.title: Add button element.
steps.description: Add a button element to the shadow DOM that will emit a custom event when clicked.

steps.title: Add event listener.
steps.description: Add an event listener to the button element.

steps.title: Dispatch custom event.
steps.description: When the button is clicked, dispatch a custom event with the name `my-event` and a detail of `"Hello, World!"`.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: Now your element can emit any custom event you imagine.

hero.copy: Let the form know about your custom element.

steps.title: Define formAssociated static property.
steps.description: Set the `formAssociated` static property to `true` to indicate that the custom element is form-associated.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: Now your custom element can participate in form submission and validation. Check `form.elements` to see your element.

hero.copy: Set form value from your custom element.

steps.title: Element internals.
steps.description: Attach element internals to the element instance

steps.title: Set form value.
steps.description: Use `this._internals.setFormValue()` to set the form value from your custom element.

steps.title: Done 🎉
steps.description: Now whenever you post the form, `foo` (name) will have a value `Hello, World!`.
